nc.description: A tracked mechanical device rests on an inclined plane, using adjustable struts to support a circular white platform in a horizontal position.
A 3D rendering shows a mechanical joint connecting a straight shaft to two wavy, flat structures.
A close-up shows the continuous track base and structural supports of a grey and white 3D-rendered mechanical model.

A 3D rendering displays an abstract cylindrical structure with curved strands emerging from one end and angled channels from the other, positioned near two floating rectangular plates and a lumpy mass.
A central grey knob is surrounded by a radiating pattern of grey rectangular blocks on a white surface.

vc.description: A grey, sculpted model of a wheeled mechanical structure is positioned on a rough, sloped surface against a white background.
A grey, sculpted mechanical assembly consists of organic, flowing forms on the left that connect to a central gear and chain mechanism, which is gripped by a rigid arm and clamp on the right.
A close-up view displays the textured, metallic components of a bicycle's belt-driven drivetrain, including the crank arms, pedals, sprocket, and belt.
A light grey mechanical assembly composed of springs, cables, a jointed central mechanism with a suspended weight, angled pipes, and gears is displayed against a white background.
A central mechanical assembly featuring gears, pulleys, and springs is surrounded by a radial arrangement of toggle clamps and metal extrusions on a white background.
